schema.description: The Bria FIBO edit fields, shared by the v1 `POST /proxy/bria/v2/image/edit` request body and the Comfy Router input schema for `bria/fibo`. See the note above this component for why the two surfaces share properties but not `model_version`'s constraints.

guidance_scale.description: Determines how closely the generated image should adhere to the instruction.

images.description: The source image to be edited. Publicly available URL or Base64-encoded. Accepted formats JPEG, JPG, PNG, WEBP. Must contain exactly one item.

instruction.description: Text-based edit instruction (e.g., "make the sky blue", "add a cat"). Either instruction or structured_instruction must be provided.

ip_signal.description: If true, returns a warning for potential IP content in the instruction.

mask.description: Optional mask image URL or Base64-encoded. Black areas will be preserved, white areas will be edited.

model_version.description: The version of the model to use. Comfy Router supplies this from the `{model}` path segment, so omit it there; the value Bria runs is `FIBO`, which the v1 route also defaults to when the field is absent. Not constrained to an enum on this half: Router writes the value in after the caller's body has been validated.

negative_prompt.description: A text prompt specifying concepts, styles, or objects to exclude from the edited image.

prompt_content_moderation.description: If true, returns 422 on instruction moderation failure.

seed.description: Seed for deterministic generation. If omitted, a random seed is used.

structured_instruction.description: A string containing the structured edit instruction in JSON format. Use this instead of instruction for precise, programmatic control.

sync.description: Must be false or omitted. Bria's synchronous mode (true) is refused rather than forwarded, on Comfy Router and on this operation's own `/proxy/` route: Comfy Router fixes the return mode before dispatch and polls for the result inside the call, and the `/proxy/` route returns the request_id and status_url to poll.

visual_input_content_moderation.description: If true, returns 422 on images or mask moderation failure.

visual_output_content_moderation.description: If true, returns 422 on visual output moderation failure.
